# CodeBlock — @tecton/react/code-block

```tsx
import { CodeBlock, CodeBlockHeader, CodeBlockTitle, CodeBlockActions, CodeBlockCopyButton, CodeBlockContent, CodeBlockLine, CodeBlockFooter } from "@tecton/react/code-block"
```

## Use it when

- Showing code, a configuration file, a query or terminal output that the reader copies or reads line by line.
- Showing a diff, or calling out lines of a longer snippet.
- Streaming tool output or generated code into a conversation as it arrives.

## Not for

- a single value the user copies, such as an ID or a URL → `CopyButton` (tecton docs copy-button)

## Do

- Pass the text as a string to `CodeBlockContent`; it stays one text node, so it is cheap while output streams.
- Put a `CodeBlockTitle` and a `CodeBlockCopyButton` with the same `value` in `CodeBlockHeader`, or put `CodeBlockActions` straight inside `CodeBlock` for floating actions.
- For syntax colours, map the lines from `useHighlightedCode(code, language)` (`@tecton/react/use-highlighted-code`) to `CodeBlockLine`s.
- Mark lines with `CodeBlockLine` `variant="highlighted" | "added" | "removed"`, and use `lineNumbers`, `startLine`, `wrap` and a `max-h-*` class on `CodeBlockContent` for the rest.

## Don't

### HIGH A code sample in a bare pre

Wrong:

```tsx
<pre className="overflow-auto rounded-md bg-muted p-4 font-mono text-sm">{query}</pre>
```

Correct:

```tsx
<CodeBlock>
  <CodeBlockHeader>
    <CodeBlockTitle>Production query</CodeBlockTitle>
    <CodeBlockActions>
      <CodeBlockCopyButton value={query} />
    </CodeBlockActions>
  </CodeBlockHeader>
  <CodeBlockContent>{query}</CodeBlockContent>
</CodeBlock>
```

A bare `pre` takes no keyboard focus, so a long line cannot be scrolled without a mouse, and it inherits the page direction, so code reverses in a right-to-left layout; `CodeBlockContent` is focusable and always left to right.

### MEDIUM Diff markers typed into the text

Wrong:

```tsx
<CodeBlockContent>{"- choke: 32\n+ choke: 48"}</CodeBlockContent>
```

Correct:

```tsx
<CodeBlockContent>
  <CodeBlockLine variant="removed">choke: 32</CodeBlockLine>
  <CodeBlockLine variant="added">choke: 48</CodeBlockLine>
</CodeBlockContent>
```

Typed markers are copied with the code and carry no colour; the line variants draw the `+` and `−` outside the selection on the Tecton success and destructive surfaces.

Related: trace, message, copy-button
